## Order of Execution
The following is the order in which the various things are initialised and set up so you can see at what point various things happen in relation to others.

1. Apply Game Config
2. Device Initialisation
3. Engine Injections
    1. Endpoints Set
    2. Frame Connection Instantiated
4. Game Injections
    - This is your Projects ContainerModule bindings
    - Happens in the order defined in your ContainerModule
5. Bootstrap
    1. Frame Connection Connected
    2. FeatureToggles loaded
    2. Factory Injections
        1. Skin Initialised
        2. Admin Settings Fetched
        1. Strings loaded (if not manually bound)
        4. Mobile Web Settings Config set
        5. Cabinet instantiated
    3. Vue Router Setup
    4. Initialise Auth
    5. AssetQuality set
    6. Load core-asset-list
    7. Load core assets
    8. Load skin-asset-list
    9. Load skin assets
    10. Initialise Fonts
    11. Setup Server callbacks
    12. Grab User Preferences
    13. Process Resume Request
    14. Hide Loading Screen
6. Vues Mounted
7. PIXI Initialisation
8. Cabinet Initialisation
9. Game Initialisation
10. First resize
11. GAME READY
